facets.description: FallbackLocaleList#[] (i18n.rb line 17) calls SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym with no guard, and .compact runs too late, so a nil or unavailable default locale raises on every translation or request
The String I18n.locale is mixed with Symbol locales, so .uniq doesn't remove the duplicate 'en' and :en entries and en.yml is loaded twice

answer.reasoning: I sided with Labeler 2. The group problem describes one defect at line 17: an unguarded default_locale.to_sym that raises when the default locale is "nil or unavailable". Labeler 1 split this into two facets, nil (F1) and SiteSetting unavailable (F3). Both are at the same line and need the same fix (a guard), so they are one facet. Only two facets remain: F1 (the unguarded to_sym that raises) and F2 (String and Symbol locales defeat .uniq, so en.yml loads twice). s_08cbca4d reports both, so it is complete. s_389b8963 reports only the nil crash (F1). s_831e218a reports only the String/Symbol problem (F2). s_df9ce485 reports only the unguarded lookup (F1) and never mentions the String/Symbol mismatch.
